business_problem: Genscom wanted to automate highly personalized print campaigns at scale, but it needed to digitize legacy print assets, combine live customer data with physical production, and handle order spikes without sacrificing layout quality.
solution_summary: Genscom uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Genscom wanted to automate highly personalized print campaigns at scale, but it needed to digitize legacy print assets, combine live customer data with physical production, and handle order spikes without sacrificing layout quality. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform manages the machine learning models that digitize archived layouts and support intelligent document understanding, serving as the compute layer. BigQuery stores and cleans the company and campaign data used to personalize B2B print outreach, serving as the storage layer. Cloud Run functions pull and clean target-company information from websites to automate personalized campaign preparation, serving as the serving layer. Firestore stores client data in separate databases that can grow as customer profiles expand, serving as the storage layer.
